title: R2 fix: cleanup() must unregister CryptoCb device
description: wc_crypto2dev_cleanup() closes fds and resets pool but never calls wc_CryptoCb_UnRegisterDevice(WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID). Since wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() calls wc_CryptoCb_RegisterDevice, cleanup must unregister to maintain init/cleanup symmetry. Without this, a stale callback registration points to closed fds after cleanup.
